deploy-bot: [DEPLOY FAILED] release v2.4.2 -> prod-eu-west1 failed healthcheck (5m failure rate 18%).

deploy-bot: logs: https://internal.logs/release/3976500000

deploy-bot: recent log snippet:
```
ERROR 2026-03-20T10:21:11Z tokenizer shard 7: kv-cache miss spike -> 500
Healthcheck failed: avg latency 2.3s > 1.5s
```

nina: seeing 5xx spike on tokenizer shards, suspect kv-cache tuning in quant path.

sasha: confirming, 2.4.2 rolled kv-cache defaults tighter. we have a rollback candidate (2.4.1). @ops-oncall can we do expedited rollback in eu-west1 now?

ops-oncall: change window open for 30m. i can greenlight expedited. rollback will touch ~6 nodes, expect transient tail-latency.

jen: i can cut a 2.4.2-hotfix branch and push a patched image. need a +1 to skip canary and expedite.

roland: given failing HC, skipping canary is fine. +1 from release lead. pin prod-eu-west1 to 2.4.1 and start hotfix in staging.

nina: running rollback command now:
```
# rollback job
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/tokenizer tokenizer=registry/redwood/tokenizer:2.4.1 && kubectl rollout status deploy/tokenizer
```

deploy-bot: Action: rollback initiated by @nina. Job id: rb-3976500000. https://ci.redwood/release/rb-3976500000

e2e-bot: kicked off smoke e2e tests: tokenizer-smoke (3/4 passed), flakey token-snapshot test failing intermittently, monitoring.

ops-oncall: approve moving forward if smoke passes within 10m. i'll monitor latency and errors.

sasha: noted for release notes: revert kv-cache tuning in 2.4.2; add config flag to gate future ramps.

nina: rollback complete. prod eu-west1 now at v2.4.1. observability looks stable, errors -> baseline.

jen: opening PR for release notes + postmortem: https://git.redwood/release-notes/pull/112 (includes hotfix plan).

roland: thanks everyone. marking this expedited window closed. we'll schedule a follow-up postmortem to review rollout gating.
